title: Tiger cub in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2a1030'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#140818'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#ff9c1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ffc257' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M32 70 q4 8 2 16' stroke='#7a3b0a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 70 q-4 8 -2 16' stroke='#7a3b0a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 84 q8 3 16 0' stroke='#7a3b0a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='92' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffd9a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='92' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffd9a0'/>

  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M26 62 q24 12 48 0 l0 8 q-24 12 -48 0 z' fill='#28c06a'/>
  <path d='M70 66 l10 8 l-4 6 l-9 -8 z' fill='#1ea257'/>
  <path d='M28 62 q24 11 47 0' stroke='#7df7b0' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='25' fill='#ff9c1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='25' fill='none' stroke='#ffc257' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='8' fill='#ff9c1a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='8' fill='#ff9c1a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='4' fill='#ffb8c8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='4' fill='#ffb8c8'/>

  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d='M50 18 v8' stroke='#7a3b0a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M39 20 l3 7' stroke='#7a3b0a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M61 20 l-3 7' stroke='#7a3b0a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 40 h8' stroke='#7a3b0a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 40 h8' stroke='#7a3b0a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#fff1d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffb8c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffb8c8'/>
  <path d='M46 46 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#8a4a12' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='39' r='4.5' fill='#fff3c4'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='4.5' fill='#fff3c4'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='39' r='2.2' fill='#143018'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='2.2' fill='#143018'/>
  <circle cx='41.2' cy='37.8' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.2' cy='37.8' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M34 50 l-10 -3' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 54 l-10 2' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 50 l10 -3' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 54 l10 2' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
